posts.title: Prototyping of "Read Me"
posts.excerpt: How do I see my upcoming game and what are my next steps.
posts.body:
In this project I'm trying to mix the Synergy and Prediction mechanics into one game.

During prototyping I focused on the Prediction and wanted to be sure, that the main mechanic of reading your opponent works well in this concept and that the game loop makes prediction feel meaningful and rewarding. I believe I managed to achieve this feeling and I can move forward and experiment a bit with different actions that players could find interesting to interact with.

Once I have a pool of working, interesting and fun actions that fit the concept, I’ll be able to move on to adding progression to the gameplay. And on this stage I aim to keep the different actions synergistic so the game remains engaging throughout and offers replayability.

Stay tuned for more updates.

### You can find the Read Me page by clicking the game card in the "Upcoming Projects" section. Any feedback is very welcome.

upcoming.description: Read Me - is a small game built around prediction mechanic. You and your friend are trapped on a tiny battle field with limited amount of actions. Try to outsmart your opponent and build an unforeseen strategy
